image_description: A close-up photograph of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, bare branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head featuring white speckling, an orange-rufous breast and flanks, a white belly, and black wings with distinct white wing bars. The background is a soft, out-of-focus grey.
